card.name: Words just before solution or fluid terms
card.fires_on: The word "a" after "with" before a flush or compatible fluid, and partway through words like hypertonic, isotonic and ophthalmic that precede "solution" or "saline".

modes.label: "a" before flush fluid
modes.description: The article "a" after "with" in line-flushing instructions, right before flush or compatible fluid.
modes.example: the patency of the intravenous (IV) catheter should be tested with<< a>> flush of sterile saline.

modes.label: Inside tonic/ophthalmic words
modes.description: The middle of words like hypertonic, isotonic or ophthalmic, where "solution" or "suspension" comes next.
